lines.t: Why does everything cost nine ninety-nine… and not ten dollars?
lines.title: WHY *$9.99?*

lines.t: Because your brain reads prices from left to right. Nine ninety-nine feels like nine dollars. Not ten.
lines.title: YOUR BRAIN SEES *$9*

lines.t: Researchers from MIT and the University of Chicago tested the same item at three prices: thirty-four, thirty-nine and forty-four dollars.
Which one sold the most? The thirty-nine dollar one. It beat both… even the cheaper price.
It's called charm pricing. And this Black Friday, it's on almost every tag you'll see.
lines.title: CHARM *PRICING*

lines.t: Follow for more money tricks stores don't want you to notice.
lines.title: DON'T GET *TRICKED*
